metadata.domain: Autonomous Driving Platform / ADAS / Automotive Electronics

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL6→completion in 2 years) and T03 (TRL7→completion in 0 quarters, same start/end date 2030-Q1) are problematic — T03 effectively has zero development time allocated despite being TRL7 with a non-trivial dependency chain. T08 at TRL5 gets 2 years which is borderline but feasible.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared 기술선도 strategy would expect lower-TRL exploratory technologies and R&D-heavy portfolio, but T03 (TRL7) is near-commercialization and the portfolio of only 3 technologies is thin for true technology leadership; some alignment exists via T08 (TRL5) but overall depth is insufficient.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no discernible competitive differentiation rationale in technology selection or timing — the choices appear driven by dependency chains rather than competitive positioning or gap exploitation in the autonomous driving landscape.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도 strategy, technologies should complete 1-2 years before market boom (preemption), but all three technologies complete AFTER their respective boom windows by 0.75, 2.25, and 2.0 years respectively, representing systematic post-boom completion rather than preemption.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (sensor fusion, 3D pose estimation, steer-by-wire) are all active patent areas in autonomous driving with growing markets, suggesting some convergence awareness, but the selection of only 3 technologies and the absence of explicit convergence-zone targeting makes this appear partially coincidental.

strengths: Dependency chain is properly respected with zero violations, ensuring logical technology progression from sensing (T01) to perception (T08) to actuation (T03)
Budget is fully utilized with no overspend, indicating disciplined financial planning within constraints
weaknesses: All three technologies complete after their market boom windows (mean error 1.67 years), fundamentally undermining both market capture and the preemption intent of 기술선도 strategy
T03 (Steer-by-Wire) has identical start and end dates (2030-Q1), implying zero development time which is infeasible for any technology regardless of TRL
missing_technologies: LiDAR point cloud processing / solid-state LiDAR (lower TRL, high patent activity, core to technology leadership in autonomous driving)
Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication technology (critical for autonomous driving ecosystem, aligns with 기술선도 strategy)
AI-based end-to-end driving model / neural network inference accelerator (foundational for competitive differentiation)
investment_issues: All technologies are classified as Strategic or High tier with no Core/Exploratory balance, inappropriate for a 기술선도 strategy that should include more speculative/exploratory bets
With only 3 technologies in the portfolio and full budget consumption, the investment is over-concentrated — technology leadership typically requires a broader, more diversified exploratory portfolio
T03 receiving High tier investment despite TRL7 maturity and post-boom completion timing represents misallocation for a leadership-oriented strategy
timing_issues: 3D 포즈 추정 시스템 completes in 2030-Q1 but market boom was 2027-Q4 — a 2.25-year post-boom completion misses the primary market window entirely
스테어 바이 와이어 제어 has zero-duration development (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1) which is a scheduling artifact, not a realistic plan
All technologies follow a sequential dependency chain that pushes completion dates too late; parallel development tracks should have been explored
